postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the permutation is between 2 and 200,000.
Each element in the permutation is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: p is a permutation of length n
postconditions.description: The array p contains distinct integers from 1 to n in arbitrary order.

invariants.expression: The output for each test case is the minimum number of operations needed to have exactly one inversion in the permutation.
invariants.description: The output must ensure that there is exactly one pair (i, j) such that i < j and p_i > p_j.
